title: phyllitis rhizophylla
intro: Phyllitis rhizophylla, commonly known as Liparis or Kuzukoboku in Japanese, is a type of plant species in the Ascomycota phylum. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Phyllitis rhizophylla include modulating immune responses and exhibiting anti-proliferative effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
